t: Teaching verification is per-adoption, not periodic full re-audit
signal: Teaching adoption verification belongs at adoption time (Step 5), not wakeup time. Verify each teaching's fingerprint immediately before moving it to processed/. Full re-audits are a one-time catch-up, not a recurring pattern. Once baseline is clean, enforcement is forward-only.
rationale: Full re-audit at every wakeup wastes context scanning 90+ already-verified teachings. Per-adoption verification catches failures at the moment of adoption when they are cheapest to fix. The one-time full audit establishes a clean baseline; after that, the invariant is maintained incrementally.

t: Taste System: taste.spoke.yaml + taste.user.yaml schema, Historian nudge loop, wakeup integration, spoke bootstrap kit

content.what: Implement the complete Taste system: (1) taste.spoke.yaml in spoke repo — project preferences, Historian can append proposed entries; (2) taste.user.yaml in hub — user preferences shared cross-spoke, synced via teach/learn; (3) wakeup Step 5a loads and merges both; (4) Historian post-review proposes nudges with approval gate; (5) starter template included in spoke bootstrap kit.
content.why: Taste files have never been bootstrapped on spokes despite the Track+Historian+Taste epic being marked complete. Spokes log 'No taste files found — skipped' every session. Without taste, learned preferences cannot accumulate — the Historian's nudge output loop is permanently disabled. Sourced from WAIWeb Historian first pass (2026-03-26).

taste_spoke.scope: Project-level. Overrides taste.user on conflict. Checked into spoke repo.
taste_spoke.schema_note: Use existing framework taste.spoke.yaml as schema reference — it already has the accepted format
taste_spoke.seed_template: Create starter-taste-spoke.yaml in framework templates/ for spoke bootstrap

taste_user.scope: User-level. Cross-spoke. Read-only for spoke agents.
taste_user.sync: Spoke Historian proposes via outbox teaching. Hub owner applies. Spoke learns on next wai-learn.
taste_user.schema: Same as taste.spoke plus spoke_source field per entry

wakeup_integration.step: 5a — after track reading, before historian threshold check
wakeup_integration.behavior: Load taste.user from hub (if connected), load taste.spoke, merge (spoke wins on conflict), prepend behavioral summary to context
wakeup_integration.bootstrap_prompt: If no taste files found: 'Taste files not found. Create minimal taste.spoke.yaml? (Y/skip)' — replaces silent skip

historian_nudge_loop.trigger: End of each narrative review pass
historian_nudge_loop.propose_spoke: Append entries with status: proposed to taste.spoke.yaml
historian_nudge_loop.propose_user: Outbox teaching lug for hub owner to apply to taste.user.yaml

child_tasks: lug-taste-schema-finalize-v1: finalize taste.user.yaml schema (hub path, entry format, spoke_source field)
lug-taste-bootstrap-template-v1: create starter-taste-spoke.yaml for new spokes

lug-taste-historian-nudge-v1: update historian.yaml with post-review nudge proposal steps

lug-taste-teaching-file-v1: write taste-system-v1.md.teaching for distribution to all spokes
